run_mrp_multiproc_setup: run mrp.main() to start alice and bob processes defined in msetup.py using Conda runtimes
define_mrp_process_with_conda: define a named process using mrp.process with mrp.Conda runtime and a run_command list
create_conda_runtime_config: create a mrp.Conda runtime with a yaml env file and python3 run command
review_mrp_process_definitions: review the mrp.process definitions for alice and bob to check their Conda runtime configs
refactor_msetup_processes: refactor msetup.py to add or remove mrp.process definitions with different runtime configurations
